responses.demo_timeseries: Yes, sometimes (e.g., occasional use at work/research)
responses.demo_ai_experience:
Performed detailed QA reviews to validate outputs against established guidelines, taxonomies, and
workflow processes, ensuring consistent review standards across projects. Trained large‑language models on the core responsibilities, workflows, and deliverables of Market Research Analysts and Marketing Specialists by creating real-world marketing tasks as verifiable ground truth to compare against LLM outputs.
Annotated data samples, analyzed conversational text, multi-turn dialogue logs, and model-generated
outputs using structured labeling frameworks and annotation guidelines.
Evaluated the accuracy and logical flow of complex executive operations, focusing heavily on
scheduling, multi-leg travel arrangements, and event logistics.
Wrote clear justifications and source data citations to support intent and entity tagging decisions.
Flagged ambiguous data, systematically identified and escalated out-of-scope, conflicting, or
contextually ambiguous user messages with clear written explanations.
Annotated and segmented key events within short video clips according to project guidelines.
